validated_results.title: Polymorphisms in Genes Encoding Glutathione Transferase Pi and Glutathione Transferase Omega Influence Prostate Cancer Risk and Prognosis.
validated_results.reason: The study examines GSTO1, GSTO2, GSTM1, GSTT1 and GSTP1 polymorphisms as susceptibility markers rather than any nutritional glutathione exposure, providing only genotype-based risk estimates.

validated_results.title: The role of caveolin-1 and endothelial nitric oxide synthase polymorphisms in susceptibility to prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: Risk estimates are reported for CAV1 and eNOS genotypes rather than for a population-wide nutritional nitric oxide exposure, with serum nitrite/nitrate serving only as a genotype-related measure.

validated_results.title: Dietary Tomato Consumption and the Risk of Prostate Cancer: A Meta-Analysis.
validated_results.reason: This is a meta-analysis pooling 10 prospective studies of tomato consumption and prostate cancer risk rather than an original human study.

validated_results.title: Dietary Phytochemicals in Zinc Homeostasis: A Strategy for Prostate Cancer Management.
validated_results.reason: The article is a narrative review discussing dietary phytochemicals including curcumin and zinc homeostasis in prostate cancer, with no original incidence data.

validated_results.title: Dietary Carbohydrate Intake Glycemic Index and Glycemic Load and the Risk of Prostate Cancer among Iranian Men: A Case-Control Study.
